name: breaker_ds1_io_formats
description: IO boundary, decoding (>4KB NUL), JSONL fallback, JSON wrapper split collapse, base64 wrapping, LeakGate limits

attacks.fails_because: aegis/io/decode.py:18,28 only checks raw[:4096] for b'\x00', so the file passes decode() instead of being quarantined.

attacks.attack: JSON Lines (.jsonl) content inside a .csv file
attacks.fails_because: formats.py:75 calls _looks_json() via single-doc json.loads -> ValueError(Extra data) -> _parse_csv breaks JSON objects across col:N using line-0 values as column headers.

attacks.attack: Wrapper metadata key 'patient_export_source' collapses visits array into one doc record
attacks.fails_because: formats.py:156 matches 'patient' in _PERSON_KEY on a scalar metadata field and returns [], merging all /visits/* rows into a single 'doc' record so per-patient linkage breaks.

attacks.attack: Data-URI prefix and 32-char newline-wrapped Base64 attachments
attacks.fails_because: formats.py:48-54 _b64_text() uses strict _B64_RX.fullmatch(v) without stripping 'data:...;base64,' or newlines, leaving encoded PII untouched in output.

attacks.attack: 950-level nested JSON right below CPython RecursionError (~1000)
attacks.fails_because: formats.py:88,173 relies on RecursionError instead of an explicit depth cap, so extreme nesting passes unquarantined (or hits platform-dependent recursion limits).
Must trigger RecursionError -> Unsupported('json_too_deep') -> quarantine; if copied raw or processed, canary leaks.
leakgate.py:52 enforces 2 <= len(toks) <= 4; both single-word names ('Sakshi') and 5-word names are silently skipped by LeakGate cross-file scrubbing.

attacks.attack: Unlabelled repeat of 1-token and 5-token names in narrative text
attacks.fails_because: Even if detect catches them in CSV, LeakGate cannot propagate 1-token or 5-token names into free text.

attacks.attack: cp1252 CSV with 2 commas in header vs 3 semicolons per data row
attacks.fails_because: formats.py:94-98 _sniff_delimiter checks ONLY line 0 (',' count 2 > ';' count 1), collapsing every data row into col:0 under context='id'.

attacks.attack: FHIR subject reference with ?_format=json query suffix
attacks.fails_because: formats.py:296-301 _sync_fhir_refs only rewrites exact string matches in ref_map, leaving Patient/pat-901?_format=json broken or leaking old ID.
Must raise Unsupported('malformed_json') and quarantine without copying canary.
